summary: This document records the Iceberg Spark integration updates, covering new features such as DSv2 validation, geometry bounds in Parquet writers, and runtime filtering improvements, along with bug fixes for ORC variant handling and vectorized reads. The discussion proposes adding a new stream-from-snapshot option to Spark’s Iceberg connector, allowing users to choose whether to load the current snapshot first or start from the oldest ancestor. The community debates whether this initial snapshot load should be the default or an opt‑in feature, citing concerns about data consistency when deletes or overwrites occur. Options include keeping the meeting at 15:00 UTC year‑round or pinning it to 8 AM US Pacific time, with contributors from the US, Europe, and Asia weighing in on the impact of each choice.
